p8_b0.ocr: In the UK HM Treasury report for FY2023, the tax revenue composition is detailed as follows: Direct Taxes comprise Income Tax amounting to $150B, representing 40% with a rating of High; Indirect Taxes include Value Added Tax at $120B, 32% with a Medium rating, followed by Excise Duty, Alcohol Tax at $10B (3%, Medium), and Tobacco Tax at $5B (1%, Low).

p8_b1.ocr: Property Taxes consist of Council Tax totaling $30B (8%, Medium) and Business Rates at $15B (4%, Medium). Other Taxes include Capital Gains Tax at $25B (7%, Medium) and Inheritance Tax at $10B (2%, Low), culminating in Total Revenue of $375B (100%, N/A) and a Growth Rate of 3.5%, with the Previous Year at $362B and a forecast of $400B.
